question: The radius of the incircle of an equilateral triangle is 9√3 cm. What will be the perimeter of this equilateral triangle?
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the incircle of an equilateral triangle = 9√3 cm

**Concept Used:**

In an equilateral triangle, the radius of the incircle is related to the side length (s) by the formula:

The radius of incircle = side / 2√3

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9d3b880590ebac10a16b88c1a6ce6f5e6a37130edcc697e9c8594409f967a38.png] 

Radius of incircle = side / 2√3

⇒ 9√3 = side / 2√3

⇒ side = 9√3 × 2√3 = 18 × 3 = 54 cm

So, Perimeter of an equilateral triangle = 3 × side = 3 × 54 = 162 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
